description: This file contains functions and types for discovering and managing Bedrock models from AWS, including caching, filtering, and configuration resolution.

methods.name: resetBedrockDiscoveryCacheForTest
methods.description: Clears the discovery cache and resets error logging flag for testing purposes.

methods.name: resolveBedrockConfigApiKey
methods.description: Resolves the AWS SDK environment variable name used for authentication.

methods.name: discoverBedrockModels
methods.description: Discovers available Bedrock models from AWS, with caching and filtering based on configuration.

methods.name: resolveImplicitBedrockProvider
methods.description: Resolves a Bedrock model provider configuration based on environment and discovery results.

methods.name: mergeImplicitBedrockProvider
methods.description: Merges existing and implicit Bedrock provider configurations.
